articles.title: Anthropic IPO: Investors who flip the stock may face brokerage penalty
articles.summary: Anthropic said in an IPO prospectus that it expected to make shares available to retail investors through various brokerages, including Charles Schwab, Fidelity, Robinhood, SoFi, E*Trade and some of their respective affiliates. These broker-dealers have different "anti-flipping" policies meant to discourage investors who purchase IPO shares — including those of Anthropic — from dumping them quickly.

articles.title: Family offices move more money into stocks, hedge AI risk, according to CNBC Family Office Portfolio Tracker
articles.summary: Family offices continued to boost their stock holdings in the third quarter, although they hedged the artificial intelligence trade with a larger bet on financials, according to the CNBC Family Office Portfolio Tracker. The increased allocation to stocks, whether from passive market gains or active buying, shows that family offices aren't pulling back from the market despite growing fears of an AI bubble and weakness in tech stocks.

articles.title: Anthropic lifts Nasdaq futures and tech stocks ahead of its record-breaking IPO
articles.summary: With around 980 million shares sold, it has raised $81.3 billion, surpassing SpaceX's record IPO back in June. - IPO and beyond: While many investors will want to buy during the IPO, retail investors will get access if they already hold certain mutual funds or ETFs. The highly anticipated offering could present another headwind for the group, by giving investors an attractive alternative to get exposure to the AI trade.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO could create thousands of multimillionaire employees
articles.summary: A version of this article appeared in CNBC's Inside Wealth newsletter, a weekly guide to the high-net-worth investor and consumer. The average Anthropic employee could be worth over $40 million after the company's IPO today, with over 400 employees likely to be worth over $100 million, according to SEC filings and investors. It will not only be the largest IPO in history by dollar amounts, but it is also shaping up to be one of the most rapid wealth creation events in history.

articles.title: Data center electricity use could double by 2030, IEA says
articles.summary: The agency says power networks are "one of the biggest energy investment stories of the next decade." The scenario projects that renewable power generation will grow 85% more in the next decade than in the previous one. The IEA said the 2026 energy crisis could accelerate electrification as countries seek to reduce their reliance on imported oil and gas.

articles.title: Novartis raises blockbuster drug forecasts to $18 billion as it seeks to prove growth can last
articles.summary: Pharma major Novartis is becoming more optimistic about some of its biggest growth drugs, even as investors question the company's ability to sustain growth beyond 2031 and offset the financial impact of older drugs' patent expiries. Shares fell 2.4% in mid-morning trading in Switzerland. For investors, the question will be whether those drugs can grow fast enough to offset lost sales as other drugs face competition from cheaper rivals entering the market.

articles.title: 'Parasite' backer and other South Korean media, gaming and travel stocks rally on China trade deal
articles.summary: South Korean entertainment, gaming and travel stocks surged Thursday as Seoul and Beijing largely concluded a trade deal, allowing Korean companies greater access to China's vast consumer market. South Korea's gaming stocks Krafton and Shift Up advanced 2.69% and 6.57%, respectively.

articles.title: Palo Alto stock surges as all signs point to how important cybersecurity is in the AI age
articles.summary: PANW YTD mountain Palo Alto Networks YTD Following the print, in after-hours trading, shares soared 9%, after a regular Wednesday session rally that saw the stock surge nearly 10%. articles.title: Palo Alto inks $4.5 billion deal for AI startup Applied Compute, shares pop 7% on earnings
articles.summary: Palo Alto Networks shares jumped more than 7% after the cybersecurity firm beat Wall Street's fiscal first-quarter estimates and inked a deal for artificial intelligence startup Applied Compute. Fears of AI-powered cyberattacks, heightened by incidents like the Hugging Face breach, are driving demand for cybersecurity vendors like Palo Alto Networks. The startup helps businesses run and customize their own AI models and marks a major investment for Palo Alto beyond cybersecurity.

articles.title: Inside India newsletter: Foreign flows helped the market recover. Now it faces the inflation test
articles.summary: As global portfolio managers look to diversify into non-artificial intelligence trades, India, with its strong economic growth and improved corporate earnings, is emerging as a top pick. Foreign investors are returning to Indian equities in record numbers, but the country's accelerating inflation, which last month breached the central bank's comfort level for the first time in two years, could spoil the party.

articles.title: Jim Cramer says Nvidia has a new problem — and it has nothing to do with earnings
articles.summary: Complicating matters is Anthropic's blockbuster IPO, Cramer said, which is drawing investor enthusiasm further away from the chipmaker. The AI startup's explosive growth and highly anticipated market debut are giving investors another way to capitalize on the artificial intelligence boom, potentially reducing their appetite for Nvidia shares.

articles.title: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 per share, above expected range, source tells CNBC
articles.summary: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share on Wednesday, a person familiar told CNBC, above the expected range, setting the stage for the Claude creator's eagerly awaited Nasdaq listing and a historic moment for the artificial intelligence industry. Anthropic has been racing to maintain an edge over OpenAI and Google in the enterprise market, and it experienced a period of explosive growth in 2026, driven largely by the popularity of its AI coding tool, Claude Code.

articles.title: Nvidia reverses, metals crash ahead of Anthropic IPO
articles.summary: Slumping crypto prices, a big Nvidia reversal despite good earnings, and now a sharp drop-off in metals prices from gold to copper — cross-asset selling has traders wondering if Anthropic's incoming IPO is spurring a rotation trade with the aim of freeing up cash to buy stock in the AI giant when it goes public on Thursday. Shares of Nvidia swung from $164 overnight to below $152 during Wednesday's trading session despite smashing analysts' expectations on revenue and guidance.

articles.title: Why Anthropic's hot IPO is bringing out sellers — plus, a silver lining of the down market
articles.summary: While the guidance was impressive and the stock is historically cheap on an earnings basis, the quarter didn't change Jim Cramer's view that investors should take some shares off the table, if they haven't already, as a matter of capital preservation . Some of the pressure over the past few days may be tied to a bit of selling by investors making last-minute room for their Anthropic allocations ahead of Wednesday night's initial public offering (IPO) pricing and Thursday's first trade.

articles.title: Fed officials expect more rate hikes, worry about AI impact on inflation, minutes show
articles.summary: Federal Reserve officials expressed confidence in October that further interest rate increases will be needed to stem inflation, though they decided to hold off while gathering more information, according to meeting minutes released Wednesday. Policymakers put artificial intelligence at the core of their discussions, indicating that demand associated with the technology would be "a material source of inflation risk." More broadly, officials said "inflation pressures in the economy were broad...

articles.title: One of AI's most notorious 'doomers' stands to make billions in Anthropic's IPO
articles.summary: An Estonian tech billionaire famous for his stance that AI could end humanity is expected to be one of the biggest winners in Anthropic's upcoming IPO. Anthropic is set to list on the Nasdaq Thursday under the ticker symbol ANT in what could be the largest IPO of all time, and the first public debut for an AI lab.

articles.title: Retail investor enthusiasm for Anthropic IPO to rival SpaceX debut
articles.summary: The artificial intelligence laboratory — which will trade on the Nasdaq under ticker symbol ANT — is selling 825 million shares at an expected price range of $70 to $78 per share in the IPO, though sources told CNBC the stock is likely to price above that range. Waiting game To be clear, all the retail investors CNBC spoke with are optimistic on AI as a transformative technology — even the ones sitting out the IPO.

articles.title: Is Apple the safe haven investors think it is? Here's a way to trade it with less risk
articles.summary: For months, Apple has been the undisputed haven of the technology sector. As the industry grappled with the brutal reality of Nvidia's post-Huang future, investors blindly rotated into Apple, comforting themselves with the narrative that the Cupertino giant was uniquely immune to speculative overspending on artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Jensen Huang has agreed to appear before Senate banking committee, Chairman Scott says
articles.summary: The House Energy and Commerce Committee asked interim Nvidia CEO Colette Kress for a briefing no later than Dec. 2 on the company's chip exports and information about the relationship between Jensen Huang and Alice Huang. The panel also asked Lutnick and a top deputy to appear to discuss chip export controls.

articles.title: Jim Cramer looks at what turned the market lower and where stocks could go next
articles.summary: The S & P 500 reversed earlier gains and turned lower Wednesday as investors weighed the negatives of another hawkish warning from a Federal Reserve official against the positives of earnings and Anthropic's IPO. Fed Governor Christopher Waller said the central bank may need to "shock people" with a half-point interest rate hike in December to tame inflation.
